en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: To familiarize students with problems of composting of waste arising in horticulture and community sector in terms of technological processes and used machinery.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Introduction to the course (allowance 2/2) a.Agroecosystem balance, the role of soil organic matter, uses of biodegradable waste, anaerobic biodegradation, aerobic biodegradation, phase composting process.2.Factors affecting the composting process (allowance 2/2) a.Ratio of C:N, temperature, humidity, aeration, pH, the possibility of monitoring and regulation3.Optimization of raw material compositions of compost fill (allowance 2/2) a.Essay - a practical calculation4.Horticultural waste (allowance 2/2) a.Classification and brief description often applied degradable waste (leaves, wood waste, etc.)b.Essay - seasonality, balance of production of biodegradable waste from specified area5.The application of logistics in the design and operation of composting facility (allowance 2/2) a.The importance of logistics, logistics methods, material flowb.Essay - practical application of logistics methods, the proposed location of the composting facilities6.Composting technology (allowance 2/2) a.Surface fills, composting widrows, intensive composting technology7.Machines for composting (allowance 2/2) a.Machines producing coarse and fine compostb.Essay - chosing machines for composting8.Shredders, chippers, compost turners (allowance 2/2) a.The importance and process characterization, classification, working bodies9.Separation devices (allowance 2/2) a.Importance, the principles of separation and sorting mechanisms, vibrating sieves, rotary sortersb.Separators with rotating grates, separators
